prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET for a Dreamerie spot-the-difference puzzle. Return ONE altered image with the EXACT SAME 4:5 framing, geometry, textured painted style and positions. Make exactly the five specified meaningful object edits below. Match this existing illustrator's brushwork, shading and palette. NO random new props, circular patches, tint spots, labels, arrows or answer markers. Keep absolutely everything else unchanged, including background, all edges, decorations and lighting. Do not redraw or reframe the scene. Coordinates are percentages from top-left and help identify objects, not visible boxes.
1. Edit only this object so: The robin's red breast turned ochre. Target near x76%, y53%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
2. Edit only this object so: The star on the foreground fabric patch became a crescent. Target near x73%, y93%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
3. Edit only this object so: The bear closed its eye. Target near x56%, y37%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
4. Add three tiny pale stitches across the bear's left edge of its upper ear, matching the textile-like painted fur. Target near x52%, y22%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
5. Edit only this object so: The wooden spool's round central hole became square. Target near x93%, y70%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
review: Visually reviewed. Only the five declared object regions are composited over the original; labels describe actual generated changes. See edits for final accepted answers.

edits.label: The robin's red breast turned ochre.
The star on the foreground fabric patch became a crescent.
The bear's ear gained a tiny stitched repair.
The wooden spool's round central hole became square.
